tei:div.tei:p: khri skor mchog gyur zha lu ba'i byung tshul dang*/ myang yul chags lugs bzhugs so//

oṃ swa ti/ 'gro ba'i bla ma dpal ldan sa skya pa/ /'jam dbyangs rnam 'phrul rim pa'i sku drin las/ /dbus gtsang 'di yang khri stong dbang bsgyur ba'i/ /sde dpon stobs ldan che gnyan mang byung ba/ /de'i nang nas rigs bzang sku nye shing*/ khri skor bcu gsum dag gi mchog gyur pa/ /zha lu sku zhang byon tshul 'di ltar grags/ de'ang 'di ltar thos te/ sngon rgyal po khri lde 'od srung dang*/ btsun mo lcog ro bza' dkar rgyal mo legs la/ sras mnga' bdag dpal 'khor btsan/ de'i btsun mo tshe spong bza' dkar rgyal la/ sras skyid sde nyi ma mgon dang*/ bal bza' phan rgyal la/ khri bkra shis brtsegs pa dpal btsan chung btsan 'dis/ sngon ma stod phyogs su byon/ gu ge spu hreng ya tshe rnams kyi/ mnga' bdag mdzad pa la sras dpal gyi mgon dang*/ bkra shis nyi ma mgon/ lde gtsug mgon rnams byung ba la/ stod kyi mgon gsum zer ro/ /de'i rgyud stod kyi rgyal rgyud rnams yin no/ /gcung po khri bkra shis brtsegs pa dpal// rt-ing la stod phyogs su spyugs/ mnga' ris gung thang man la chags/ sras dpal ldai dang 'od ldai/ skyid ldai rnams byung ba la/ smad kyi lde gsum zer/ gcung skyid lde de/ 'jad rta nag ngos su phog pa la/ sras drug byung ba'i lnga pa'i rgyud 'gro rtsod dang*/ mus mdzad la sogs byang phyogs la yod/ sras gcig gtsang grom pa dang*/ shab sran/ myang stod smad du byon pas/ myang yul du sras gsum pa'i che ba/ khyung btsad/ bar pa bre btsad/ chung ba la lce btsad zer/ khong mched gsum gyi myang stod smad la yul bgos/ sa ris byas pa ni/ phu ha'o gangs bzang nas/ mda' bcug pa gcung pa yu ba gdong yan la/ bod 'brog cha snyoms pa'i yul sde chen po gsum du phye te/ phu byang shar ri nang spang mkhar la gtad/ mda' lho nub gangs ye sham bu la gtad pa/ bseg 'gros su yod pa la/ yul sde chen po gcig tu byas te/

gcen khyung btsad kyi sa mtsham gtsang khang brag kha yan yin/ 'di'i sa khong na phu na/ 'brog sde chen po gsum yod pa ni/ gam ru rgyang ru nying ru gsum/ bar na tshong 'dus chen po gcig yod pa ni/ sal ma tshong 'dus bya ba yod de/ phyis bkag nas gnas snying du 'phos pa'o/ /sa khong de rnams na mi rigs mi 'dra ba gnyis yod pa ni/ brag shos rnams shes rab che dge ba la brtson pa kho na yod do/ /phal shos rnams sdig shas che/ nya dang ri dwags rngon pa'o/ /zong sna mi 'dra ba gsum yod pa ni/ zha mo snam phrug phad phyar yang yod/ de skor phu'i 'brog sde ches/ mda' zhing sa khyon chung bas cha ma snyaums pas/ sha se khog tu nyo tshong byed par byung ngo*/ /bar pa ldai btsad kyi dbang rigs/ gtsang gad brag kha man/ sna bo brag rdog yan la/ yul sdai chen po gcig tu byed pa'i/ de'ang phu swa ma sā'u/ byang shar dang*/ mda' gab bya dkar/ lho nub la bstan pa/ bseg 'gros su yod pa/ phu'i 'brog sde gsum ni/ rgyang mkhar/ skyid mkhar/ mag ngag rnams so/ /bar gyi tshong 'dus gcig ni/ 'od gsum ti du dgu'i tshong 'dus bya'o/ /mi rigs mi 'dra ba gnyis ni/ brag shos rnams shin tu phyugazhan pa rnams dbul zhing 'phongs/ zong sna mi 'dra ba gsum ni/ rnga ma phyings pa/ sle khra yod do/ /phu'i 'brog sde dang*/ mda'i zhing pa rnams cha snyoms pas/ sha phyed tshong byed pa byung ngo*/ /chung ba lce btsad gyi dbang rigs/ sna bo brag rdog man bcug pa yu ba gdong yan la/ yul sdai chen po gcig tu byed/ de'ang phu byang shar 'khor stod la kha dang*/ mda' lho nub chu sgo gzhung la bstan pa/ bseg 'graus su yod pa/ de'i phu na 'brog sde gsum ni/ sgrol lcags ra gsum mo// bar gyi tshong 'dus ni/ gtsang tshong 'dus mgur mo'o/ /mi rigs mi 'dra ba gnyis ni/ brag shos rnams mdzangs shas che/ zhan shos rnams khram shas che'o// zong sna mi 'dra ba gsum ni/ gtsang ther/

dor skyegs/ star zon rnams yod do// phu'i 'brog sde chung/ mda'i zhing sa khyon ches cha ma snyoms pas/ sha gzugs tshong byed pa 'byung ngo*/ /de ltar yul bgos byas pas/ gzhan gang dang gang cha snyoms par byung na'ang*/ gam ru'i g.yam pa legs po de la gang yang yong*/ mi 'dzad pa'i gter dang 'dra bas/ phyug pa dang g.yam pas rgyal lo/ /zer byung zhing*/ da lta khyung g.yam du grags so/ /dus phyi rting btsad po mched gsum la/ dar gud byung te/ yul sde gsum ga gcung po lce btsad kyis bzung*/ de gong myang stod gzhung phal che ba zhing la thag ma dang*/ chu mig la brten pa las med pa la/ lce btsad/ shes rab dang 'byor stobs che bas sa rgya 'di la bde chod pa'i thabs dgos pa 'dug zer nas/ myang stod kyi byang rgyud du/ rtsa rnams kyi rgyal rkas dang*/ lho rgyud du spang yul bzhengs kyi 'od rka bya ba dang*/ myang smad byang du pa tshab rka mo che dang*/ lho rgyud pa snam rka mo che rnams bzos/ rka bo che re re'i 'og na son khal khri khrag re re yod par byed cing*/ rka chen rnams ma 'jags bar la bsrung mi sdod pa'i mkhar gnyis bzhengs pa ni/ stod du rgyal grogs rtsai mkhar dang*/ smad du pa snam rtse mkhar gnyis/ lce btsad kyi bzhengs pas na lce mkhar du chags pa yin la/ de lta bu'i rka chen bzhi dang mkhar gnyis ni/ da lta'i bar du yod cing*/ sa 'dul la bed spyod shin tu che bar byung bas/ lce btsad kyi byas pa lag rjes shin tu che bar gda' cing*/ zha lu ba'i dpon rgyud 'dis rtsa ba lce btsad kyi rgyud pa yin pas/ de nas gdung rabs mang rabs 'ong pas/ bod du bstan pa phyi dar gyis thog ma/ dbus gtsang gi mi bcu pos mdo smad nas chos zhus pas/ lo ston rdo rje dbang phyug gi myang smad rgyan gong gi gtsug lag khang bzhengs/ de'i dngos slob/ mgo dmag g.yu 'khrungs gi bu chen/ lce btsun sher 'byung gi zha lu wa mo'i gtsug lag khang bzhengs/

chos sde btab rgya gar du byon/ sdom pa bskyar nas blangs/ zab chos mang du zhus so// der rt-ing zha lu ba mnga' thang 'byor stobs je che la song tshul ni/ khri skor gzhan rnams las lhag pa'i/ che khyad rnam pa lnga bya ba yod de/ de yang*/ gdung rus btsad po yin pas che/ las ka bka' bzhi'i byas pas che/ dam chos rgya gar ma yin pas che/ de rnams ni gong du smaus pa ltar gdung rgyud sku zhang yin pas che/ sbyin bdag rgyal po yin pas che/ bya ba ni thog mar sku zhang ye shes kun dga'i lcam mo/ /ma cig mkha' 'gro 'bum/ 'gro mgon phyag na'i khab tu byon pa nas bzung ste/ chos rje bla ma sku mched/ bla chen kun rgyal ba yab sras la sogs/ ding sang yan/ gdung rgyud khu dbon pas sku zhang na rim gyi bar la/ sku nye 'brel ba nas/ sde bdag gzhan rnams las ches lhag par/ sa skya pa dang 'brel che'o// 'gro 'gon phyag na yab yum pa'i sras/ bla ma dharma pha la rak+ṣi ta gong du byon/ hor o ja du rgyal po dang mjal dus/ bod dbus gtsang na nged kyi zhang po zha lu khri dpon bya ba yod pa la/ lung las kha bzang po gnang dgos zhus pas/ bla ma'i zhang po yin na nged kyi yang zhang po yin du chug la/ khri skor dpon po stong dpon byings pos phud du khur ba gyis shig mi rabs kyi bar la khri skor 'jags su chug gsungs pa'i lung gtsang ma gnang ba dang*/ gong ma yon mchod kyi sku rim la dmigs nas/ gser dngul las grub pa'i rten gsum gtsug lag khang dang bcas pa bzhengs pa gyis gsungs nas/ gser bre chen brgya dang*/ dngul bre chen lnga brgyas mgo byas pa'i gnang sbyin bzang po bskur/ de'i cha rkyen gyis zha lu gser khang du grags pa'i lha khang dbu rtse che chung ngo mtshar can mang du thugs rje chen pos bzhengs/ tshong 'dus 'phrul pe bzhengs/ de'i rting sku zhang kun dga' don grub pa dang*/ sku zhang grags pa rin chen pa'i ring la/

rang byon 'phags pa spyan drangs/ zha lu gnas nang dang*/ ri phug yang dgon btab/ chos dpon la/ chos rje bu ston kha che gdan drangs/ de pa yab sras la sogs mkhas grub mang po'i zhabs tog bdag rkyen mdzad pas/ da lta'i bar du/ thub bstan nyin mo ltar gsal ba 'di lags so/ /sku zhang byon tshul myang yul chags tshul 'di bris pas sku chen gyis mchog bstan 'dzin yon mchod rnams sku tshe ring zhing*/ 'gro kun rgyal ba'i sku gsum myur du thob pa'i rgyur gyur cig dge legs 'phel gyur cig/ // mes po'i shul bzhag las/ rgyal rabs mang po'i legs bshad rnam grangs yid 'dzin nor bu'i phreng ba/khri skor mchog gyur zha lu ba'i byung tshul dang*/ myang yul chags lugs/ -PAGE 200--PAGE 199--PAGE 196-
